<parameter=code>
def info(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','M','c','N','Y'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]

    return d

print('after 5x DOWN:', info(last_transition.after_frame), 'no_impact', r.get('no_impact'))
